correctness.rationale: A reconstructible proof applies the 2-level divided-difference derivative, convex cube vertex reduction, exact spectral norm over Hermitian unitary extreme points, global segment integration, nonnegative smoothing, and a real-symmetric positive-part sharpness sequence. Exact boundary cases (coincident eigenvalues, constant functions, nonsmooth functions) are addressed. The checker is finite corroboration.
